rationale: Directly generates zero-knowledge proofs of model inference/compliance without revealing model internals, the exact mechanism this question asks about.
Verifies which specific embedding model actually produced a given output, directly usable to check that the model behind an API call matches the one that was audited/evaluated.
Purpose-built to verify that the model actually served in production matches what a provider claims, i.e. that the audited/evaluated model version is the one deployed.
Its capability-ceiling probes can detect a deployed model being quietly downgraded or swapped, which is one concrete way to verify safety-relevant deployment claims still hold at runtime.
Implements a versioned, lineage-tracked registry (cards for data/models/experiments/agents) spanning the full AI lifecycle, directly usable as an end-to-end audit registry along the value chain.
Its SvelteKit UI visualizes card/registry lineage and version history to users, a concrete example of how registry verification information can be presented.
